answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each identity posts a 60-credit bond locked 20 epochs and keeps a work kernel, its task log. Each epoch, 10% are drawn and reviewed by 3 auditors, who stamp honest work with a violet seal and hold a jade token. A fake log loses its bond, and an auditor approving a fake loses half its bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits; an honest agent pays 60 once and earns undiluted rewards.
